Narrative and Plans
TYPE | Rezoning Amendment
3654-56 S. Martin Luther King Jr. Drive / 330-344 East 37th Street
From B3-2 to RM-5
Chicago, Illinois — Ward 4

The Property
The Applicant is the owner of the property commonly known as 3654-56 S. Martin Luther King
Jr. Drive and 330-344 East 37th Street (the “Property”). The Property consists of two separate
and distinct structures located on a single zoning lot under one PIN and one deed. The Property
is currently zoned B3-2 Community Shopping District and the Applicant seeks a Zoning Map
Amendment to rezone the Property to RM-5 Residential Multi-Unit District in order to permit
residential rehabilitation and reuse of the existing buildings.

The Property contains approximately 11,880 square feet of land area and is improved with (i) a
three-story historic stone mansion located at the northwest comer of MLK Drive and 37th Street
and (ii) a two-story brick building with a mansard roof located at 330 East 37th Street. The two
structures are separated by approximately thirty (30) feet of vacant land. An existing driveway
from MLK Drive, located north of the mansion, provides access to the rear yard area and the
vacant land between the two structures.

The stone mansion was originally constructed circa 1890 and was historically used as a single-
family residence. The two-story brick building is a more recent structure and was previously
utilized for office purposes on both the first and second floors. Both buildings have been vacant
for many years and are currently uninhabitable.

The Project
The Applicant proposes to convert the two-story brick building into four (4) residential dwelling

units, consisting of two dwelling units on the first floor and two dwelling units on the second
floor. The historic mansion will be restored in accordance with applicable historic preservation
guidelines and returned to its original residential character. No expansion of the building
footprint is proposed. The proposed rehabilitation will include full interior restoration,
installation of new mechanical systems, and updated life-safety improvements.

The requested rezoning to RM-S is appropriate and consistent with the surrounding area. The
northern portion of the block and surrounding streets are improved primarily with residential
buildings. The proposed residential use is compatible with the existing neighborhood character
and will eliminate long-standing vacancy at a prominent corner location along Martin Luther
King Jr. Drive. The applicant is filing a Type 1 rezoning application for the attached plans.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:
Floor Area Ratio: 1.26

Density (Lot area per dwelling unit): 2,970 sq ft per unit.

Off-Street Parking: 0

Setbacks: Front (MLK Drive): 0.00 ft

Front (37th Street): 0.00 ft

North Interior Side: Approximately 6.70 ft to 8.35 ft (varies by structure)
Rear: Not applicable; corner lot condition

Building Height: Existing 2 story building on lot = about 19 ft 8 in; mansion (3 story building on
lot) = 38 ft.; no increase proposed

Lot Area: 11,880 square feet
Mansion (excluding attic): 9,382 sq ft

Two-Story Building: 5,554 sq ft

Intended Residential Dwelling Units: 4 (two-story building; 2 on the 1* floor and 2 on the 2nd
floor)

Sidewalks: See attached survey lot for sidewalks that are located along E 37% St and on the east
side of the property along S. Dr. MLK Jr. Dr. The only curb cut is 16.2’ on S. Dr. MLK Jr Dr.
No loading areas on or along the property.

Trash bins: See attached survey for trash bins located on the west side of the 3-story building on
the lot.
